rules.alphabet: unit LIT contains LIT, which is outside the [a-z_]+ alphabet
rules.tone-not-final: tone key not final in unit LIT
rules.bare-tone: unit LIT is a bare tone key
rules.not-syllable: unit LIT maps to LIT, which is not a syllable in the reading table
rules.no-tone-digit: unit LIT does not end in a tone digit 1-5
rules.bare-digit: unit LIT is a bare tone digit
rules.spelling-key: key LIT in unit LIT: a spelling is a-z and one tone digit ends the unit
rules.not-spelling: LIT is not a pinyin spelling on layout zh_pinyin
rules.too-long: unit LIT has \d+ letters; a code on layout zh_(?:cangjie|quick) has 1-\d
rules.not-code: unit LIT is not a code on layout zh_(?:cangjie|quick): no character of zh_cangjie\.tsv has it
rules.no-unit: LIT types no single syllable or jamo on layout ko_dubeolsik
rules.no-hanja: unit LIT: reading LIT has no hanja candidates
rules.no-base: digit LIT has no base letter in unit LIT
rules.no-variant: no variant LIT for base LIT in unit LIT
rules.not-word: unit LIT is not well-formed for en_identity
rules.vi-undefined: key LIT at position \d+ cannot follow LIT \(VNI: a digit must follow the letter it marks\)
rules.vi-not-g: D\([a-z0-9]+\) = [^ ]+ is not a syllable of G; canonical (?:Telex|VNI) types a vowel's tone key right after that vowel and its modifier key \(e\.g\. việt = (?:vieejt|vie65t)\)
